## Activity

During January 2021, North City Eye Clinic completed 268 captures. This activity represents the recorded imaging workload for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The activity record should be retained for routine operational monitoring and service review.

## Image quality

Of the 268 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.2. This indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not proceed to grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the usual support arrangements.

## Grading

A total of 62 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1. This measure records the typical interval associated with grading activity during January 2021 and should be considered alongside the monthly capture volume, the number of ungradable images, and the ungradable rate of 2.2. The clinic lead should continue to monitor these measures as part of routine site operations at North City Eye Clinic.
